from manim import *

class TeachingScene(Scene):
    def setup_layout(self, title_text, lecture_lines):
        # BASE
        self.camera.background_color = "#000000"
        self.title = Text(title_text, font_size=28, color=WHITE).to_edge(UP)
        self.add(self.title)

        # Left-side lecture content (bullets with "-")
        lecture_texts = [Text(line, font_size=22, color=WHITE) for line in lecture_lines]
        self.lecture = VGroup(*lecture_texts).arrange(DOWN, aligned_edge=LEFT).scale(0.8)
        self.lecture.to_edge(LEFT, buff=0.2)
        self.add(self.lecture)

        # Define fine-grained animation grid (4x4 grid on right side)
        self.grid = {}
        rows = ["A", "B", "C", "D", "E", "F"]  # Top to bottom
        cols = ["1", "2", "3", "4", "5", "6"]  # Left to right

        for i, row in enumerate(rows):
            for j, col in enumerate(cols):
                x = 0.5 + j * 1
                y = 2.2 - i * 1
                self.grid[f"{row}{col}"] = np.array([x, y, 0])

    def place_at_grid(self, mobject, grid_pos, scale_factor=1.0):
        mobject.scale(scale_factor)
        mobject.move_to(self.grid[grid_pos])
        return mobject

    def place_in_area(self, mobject, top_left, bottom_right, scale_factor=1.0):
        tl_pos = self.grid[top_left]
        br_pos = self.grid[bottom_right]
        
        # Calculate center of the area
        center_x = (tl_pos[0] + br_pos[0]) / 2
        center_y = (tl_pos[1] + br_pos[1]) / 2
        center = np.array([center_x, center_y, 0])
        
        mobject.scale(scale_factor)
        mobject.move_to(center)
        return mobject

class Section2Scene(TeachingScene):
    def construct(self):
        # Data from storyboard
        lecture_lines = [
            "We can extend the 3D equation to n-dimensions.",
            "The algebra remains consistent beyond three dimensions.",
            "S-n represents the surface of the n-sphere.",
            "B-n refers to the solid n-dimensional ball.",
            "Mathematical logic works where our visualization fails."
        ]
        self.setup_layout("Generalizing the Equation", lecture_lines)
        
        # === Animation for Lecture Line 1 ===
        # Visualizing the 2D case first
        self.play(self.lecture[0].animate.set_color(WHITE))
        eq2d = MathTex("x^2 + y^2 = r^2", color=WHITE)
        self.place_in_area(eq2d, 'C2', 'C5', scale_factor=1.2)
        self.play(Write(eq2d))
        self.wait(1)

        # === Animation for Lecture Line 2 ===
        # Generalizing to 3D
        self.play(self.lecture[1].animate.set_color(WHITE))
        eq3d = MathTex("x^2 + y^2 + z^2 = r^2", color=WHITE)
        self.place_in_area(eq3d, 'C2', 'C5', scale_factor=1.2)
        self.play(Transform(eq2d, eq3d))
        self.wait(1)

        # === Animation for Lecture Line 3 ===
        # Moving to n-dimensions and labeling the surface S^n
        # Matching Green color #00FF00
        self.play(self.lecture[2].animate.set_color("#00FF00"))

        self.place_in_area(eqnd, 'C2', 'C5', scale_factor=1.0)
        
        sn_label = MathTex("S^n", color="#00FF00")
        self.place_at_grid(sn_label, 'B4', scale_factor=1.2)
        
        self.play(
            Transform(eq2d, eqnd),
            FadeIn(sn_label)
        )
        self.play(Indicate(sn_label, color="#00FF00"))
        self.wait(1)

        # === Animation for Lecture Line 4 ===
        # Introducing the ball B^n
        # Matching Red color #FF0000
        self.play(self.lecture[3].animate.set_color("#FF0000"))
        bn_label = MathTex("B^n", color="#FF0000")
        self.place_at_grid(bn_label, 'D4', scale_factor=1.2)
        
        self.play(FadeIn(bn_label))
        self.play(Indicate(bn_label, color="#FF0000"))
        self.wait(1)

        # === Animation for Lecture Line 5 ===
        # Highlighting the 'n' to emphasize the jump to hyperspace
        # Matching Magenta color #FF00FF
        self.play(self.lecture[4].animate.set_color("#FF00FF"))
        
        # Highlighting the 'n' index in the generalized equation
        # Manual placement of high-light circle
        n_highlight = Circle(radius=0.35, color="#FF00FF").set_stroke(width=5)
        self.place_at_grid(n_highlight, 'C4')
        n_highlight.shift(RIGHT * 1.1 + DOWN * 0.1) # Center on 'n'
        
        self.play(Create(n_highlight))
        for _ in range(2):
            self.play(n_highlight.animate.scale(1.2), run_time=0.4)
            self.play(n_highlight.animate.scale(1/1.2), run_time=0.4)
        
        self.wait(2)
